subject: gh-pool
label: The land did the pool too
from: The Archive's reading: the only one of the four bodies that was a CHOICE — Victoria Eriksson with a design brief
to: THE LAND AGAIN. Torie wanted it, and THE WOODS SAID BET
note:
THE ARCHIVE WROTE A CLOSING LINE IT LIKED AND THE LINE WAS WRONG. It filed the pool as the one deliberate body on this property — the houses being the land's doing, the pool being Torie's. It was the land BOTH TIMES.

WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENS: Bryn draws something GRANDIOSE. A proper pool, a proper pool house, planned the way a woman plans a thing she has wanted for a decade of arcs. TORIE HAS OTHER IDEAS. And the same soil that shaped Ghost Haven around Bella, Specter Haven around Arianna and Banshee Haven around Bell goes — verbatim — BET, LET ME GET SOME POPCORN.

IT GOES IN POOL-SHAPED. THE FAMILY COMES BACK TWO DAYS LATER AND IT IS AB-SHAPED. Torie is insufferable about it.

SO THE MECHANISM IS UNCHANGED ACROSS ALL FOUR. Nobody on this land has ever built the body they drew. A woman wants something loudly enough near ground that has been listening for decades, and the ground answers. Bella bent over the most. Arianna anchored the chaos. Elspeth could not keep her hands off Bell's chest through the whole construction. AND TORIE LIKES GROPING HER WIFE'S ABS.

FOUR BUILDINGS, FOUR BODIES, AND NOT ONE OF THEM DRAWN BY THE WOMAN IT BELONGS TO.
